    Hau Abaut letting (STATUS FASLOAD) return the LDBSAR of the currently-
    being-loaded-file, if executed within a fasloading, or NIL of not

    resultant file is, and ^B breaks could snoop around a little more.

LDBSAR when it is done or else thee closed file-array hangs around...
